notes.title: AI Bots
notes.content:
In this update, AI cantrolled bots has been added to the game. You can choose between 4 difficulties (easy, medium, hard & extreme) and challenge them in 
singleplayer or in local multiplayer.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30740189/3bb1237b4a137d04eee6a886e00609f13f880ec3.png

Other changes:

 Small tweaks to the rotation system (further changes will be done in future updates)
 Pieces no longer have instant locking when on top of the grid
 Some bugs that occured sometimes in online due to poor connection have been patched

notes.title: Update 1/5/19
notes.content:
In this update, a new Battle has been introduced: Giant Battle. Now you can throw at other players supersized pieces and see how they deal with them! 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30740189/181e71f47df9b2b8ab6056c7c7280f00207dc078.png

Other changes to the game include:

 Now you can play the game within a resizable windowed.
 Initial rotation of the L and J pieces was changed.
 The rotation system has been tweaked to allow more SRS twists.
 The was an exploit were that game would detect a 180-rotation as a twist (when it wasn't). It has also been fixed.
 Some other minor bugs have been fixed as well.

notes.title: Gamemode Rework
notes.content:
The gamemodes have been reworked to be a tad less confusing and allow even more options. In this new update there are 4 gamemodes: Race, Timed, Survival and Endless.

Race
Race against opponents to see who can reach the objective faster. It can also be played on singleplayer, where you just try to reach the objective as fast as you can.
There are two options for this gamemode: the objective type (score, lines, color lines...)  as well as the quantity required to win.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30740189/a5f0240795fbdd9f2364f9963a0c14dae7aad47a.png

Timed
Try to achive as much as you can in a limited amount of time. This can also be player either in singleplayer or multiplayer.
This gamemode also has two options: the time limit and the objective type.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30740189/cc07366412ec47b19bd6ea3bd05c575b6dcdb0c9.png

Survival
Try to stay alive for the longest. Last player standing wins. This is a purely multiplayer gamemode. If you try to play survival in singleplayer, it will be automatically set to Endless.
This gamemode has no options.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30740189/9cad1d513b41415c0166a04d667432f115a3dce9.png

Endless
Same as Race, but without any limits. Just keep playing until all players have been eliminated.
This gamemode has only one option: the objective type.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30740189/e4eb66ddc99f7e7a73ee0b2dd49349da58cb99c7.png

Other

 The top-out condition was also changed. Now in order to be eliminated, the piece must be fully above the playfield when it is locked. This will allow for some rather interesting comebacks.
 Added pop-ups for the other players in online multiplayer.
 Fixed a couple of visual bugs that would occur form time to time

notes.title: Update 13/4/2019
notes.content:
Bug fixes:

 Changed the S and Z colors (they were swapped)
 Cheese now works as intended on online
 Combo gamemode now works on online
 Fixed several typos on the lobby screen and on the menu tooltips
 Fixed the Left and Right rotations (they were inversed)
 Fixed some online sync errors that would sometimes occur


Changes:

 The battle bar of the other players in online multiplayer is now visible
 Rebalanced most battles (especially Cubic Battle and Copy Battle).
 Added soud effects to some power-ups
 Added an in-game link to the official Discord server.
 Removed the Global Chat system.

notes.title: Online Overhaul
notes.content:
The multiplayer system has been completely reworked. With this newly built scheme, it is now possible to play online & local multiplayer at the same time! By that what I mean is that now you can go to an online lobby with multiple local users and still be able with people around the globe.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30740189/c3a7683affec727594d61076d1510d733a9035b9.png
Above we can see an example: I am playing with a friend in my house and at the same time we are playing with 12 other players on a lobby.

There are also some other small tweaks:

 Added two new piece sets: No Line and Extreme
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30740189/97a2348d33ce0bdfa689b73edb426cb7464214bb.png
 Added a new Battle mode: Speed Battle, where you can make your opponents go faster by clearing lines
 Tweaked the Piece, Cubic & Line battles a bit
 Added a new setting: Speed Change. This controls the rate at which the speed of the game will increase as you clear lines
 Added one new skin and modified some existing ones
 Fixed a couple of small visual bugs that occured when playing online multiplayer
 Changed some menu tooltips to make them clearer and easier to understand
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30740189/4672c3aee4c031254b1db87be942eda6b214c3cf.png
The 'Wide' skin, one of the skins that was changed.


And that is all! 
If you have any other ideas you would like to see in-game, just post them here.

notes.title: Update 20/1/2019
notes.content:
Added the option to turn off piece trails.
 Tweaked some visual issues regarding pop-up texts.

notes.title: Global Chat Update
notes.content: A Global Chat has been added in order to improve matchmaking and make it easier for players to find other players online. The chat shows the number of connected players at the time. It also flashes when a new message is received.

notes.title: Patch 13/1/2019
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause the Quick Join button to not do anything.
 Fixed a bug that would make the Friends Only lobbies to not be joinable by anyone.
 Added a 'Lobby List' header on top of the actual lobby list.


This is how said header looks:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30740189/987e97ed8cb3b8b9b13cdc96cf086dfc0834a7da.png

notes.title: Update 10/1/2019
notes.content:
Introduced a new feature: Preview. This lets you change the number of pieces visible below the Next sign.
 Tweaked the Hypersplit pieceset.
 Added two new piecesets: Lite Pentominos and Lite Pentasplit.

notes.title: Patch 9/1/2019
notes.content:
Fixed a couple of bugs:

 Fixed a bug where the settings wouldn't automatically save.
 Fixed a bug that made the first ghost piece in a game not render properly.
